[LSER.7.6.3] A series may be declared on a schema of any
lifecycle. On `logical` schemas, sample absorption follows
the no-op reassertion discipline ([LFAC.2]) — samples enter
on meaningful updates only. On every other lifecycle, every fact
assertion absorbs as a sample; `ttl` has no no-op suppression
because each fact assertion is meaningful by `ttl`'s own
framing per [LFAC.1.3].
